author: @httweets
title: Quavo Talks New Album, Fatherhood, Viral 'Hotel Lobby' And Working On Migos Project With Offset
text:
• Quavo has spent much of his career setting trends, but is now focused on what will last.
• He is a father to a daughter and says that growth is at the heart of his new album "QRÖMELIFE,” out Friday.
• The 14-track offering is executive produced by Pharrell Williams, who helped Quavo tune out the noise and return to his melodic instincts.
• The album features appearances from Justin Timberlake, Tyler, The Creator, A$ Rocky, Future and Lil Baby.
• It reunites Quavo with Offset after the two repaired their relationship following a public falling out in 2022.
• Quavo's 2022 "Hotel Lobby" performance has fueled a flood of AI-generated videos featuring various celebrities and animals.
• Quavo spoke about the meaning behind "QRÖMELIFE," how Pharrell helped him tune out the algorithm, the viral resurgence of "Hotel Lobby" and a new Migos project.
• Quavo's new album is a way of life, a state of being that is about overcoming challenges and coming out strong.
• He wants to be a good father to his daughter, as he did not have a father figure in his own life.
• Quavo is working on a new Migos project with Offset, which will honor the legacy of their late nephew and fellow Migos member Takeoff.
• The project is still in the cooking stage, but the chemistry between Quavo and Offset is still there.
• Quavo has been inspired by the outpouring of love and support for his nephew Takeoff, and wants to use his music to benefit the estate.
• Quavo has been working on the new Migos project with Offset, and is dumping all their ideas together to see what they can come up with.
• The experience of losing Takeoff has made Quavo realize that he can be a source of support for other families going through similar struggles.
• Quavo is turning his pain into something positive by becoming a source of comfort for others.
summary: The 14-track offering is executive produced by Pharrell Williams, who Quavo says helped him tune out the noise and return to the melodic instincts that made him a defining voice with the rap group Migos. The album features appearances from Justin Timberlake, Tyler, The Creator, A$ Rocky, Future and Lil Baby. “QRÖMELIFE” arrives as Quavo and Takeoff's 2022 ”Hotel Lobby" performance fuels a flood of AI-generated videos featuring everyone from Barack and Michelle Obama and Spider-Man to soccer stars Erling Haaland and Jude Bellingham — even dogs and cats.
